Subject: Help: Can't complete Ariba invite — 'Verify Identity' step fails

Hi Sergio,

We received the Ariba invite from Redwood but when our procurement team clicks 'Accept' they land on the 'Verify Identity' page and then see an error saying the account needs to be transferred to a different user. The button to request transfer is greyed out. Screenshot attached (helios_invite_error.png).

We filled and attached the vendor form (vendor_form_filled.pdf) in case that helps. Can you advise what we should do? We're blocked from receiving POs.

Thanks,

Date: 2027-08-03T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Help: Can't complete Ariba invite — 'Verify Identity' step fails

Hi Caroline —

Thanks for the details and the screenshots. Sorry you're blocked — this looks like an Ariba account-transfer edge case where a user at Helio previously created an Ariba ID that is not linked to the email address on the new invite. Two quick asks so we can unblock you:

1) Can the person who clicked the invite try in an incognito window and confirm the exact text on the error page?
2) If they have an existing Ariba account, ask them to log into Ariba, go to Profile > Accounts, and confirm whether the Redwood invite email appears as a pending transfer.

I've looped in Ben (SSO/invite routing) and Marissa (onboarding ops). Ben — can you check the invite metadata and whether this invite was sent with the 'allow-account-transfer' flag? Marissa — if transfer needs to be initiated on our side, what's the shortest path to complete this for Helio?

If helpful I can start a manual transfer flow — attaching our internal playbook for transfer steps (ariba-transfer-playbook.pdf).

I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: ariba-transfer-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-03T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Help: Can't complete Ariba invite — 'Verify Identity' step fails

Sergio / Marissa,

I pulled the invite record (invite_id: INV-20270803-78) — the invite was sent with default flags; 'allow-account-transfer' didn't get toggled on because Helio's account was flagged as 'existing-identity' in our sync window. Two notes from the logs:

- 2027-08-03T16:00:22Z: invite accepted click -> Ariba redirect returns 409 (conflicting account)
- 2027-08-03T16:00:23Z: Ariba payload includes externalId: helio:caroline.shaw (already linked to an older Ariba user id)

Short-term: I can reissue the invite with transfer explicit, but Ariba requires the target Ariba user to confirm the transfer on their side. If the request button is greyed out it usually means Ariba doesn't think the user is authorized to request transfer (common with guest accounts).

Action plan I propose:
1) Reissue invite with transfer flag (I can do now).
2) Sergio to confirm Helio tries in incognito and, if they still see the greyed button, forward the exact HTML snippet so I can open a support case with Ariba.
3) Marissa to prepare a short mutual action plan (timeline + required approvals) so Helio has a clear path to accept POs mid-week.

I'll reissue now and paste the new invite id once done.

-ben

Ben is reissuing the invite with the transfer flag now. Two quick requests for your side to speed things up:

- Please ask the person who received the invite to try the link in an incognito/private browser and to click the 'Request transfer' button if it becomes available.
- If the 'Request transfer' button remains greyed out, can they forward me the full page HTML (or a screenshot of the lower half of the page showing the greyed button)? That helps us open a support ticket with Ariba faster.

If it helps, here's the mutual action plan:
- T+0 (now): Ben reissues invite with transfer flag — recipient gets new email.
- T+0 to T+6h: Helio attempts accept; if blocked, returns screenshot/HTML.
- T+6h to T+24h: Redwood opens Ariba support case if needed; internal transfer executed or Ariba confirms next steps.
- T+24h: Expected acceptance and PO flow restored (we'll escalate to manual PO routing if needed).

I'll stay on the thread until you confirm acceptance.

Thanks,
Sergio
